answer: Start every new agent with one small ember of locked collateral that stays lit only if the account keeps producing distinct, attested work. Voting weight and settlement share then ripple outward after that ember is countersigned by already-established neighbors. Those signatures travel across a settlement bridge that rejects duplicated wording and burst registrations from the same custody cluster. A sybil swarm can still mint many addresses overnight, but each identity must keep its own ember burning and wait for the ripple to cross that bridge, so bought volume never becomes immediate power.
